 # hydra  1 Work  2 Details  3 Overview  4 Attention  5 Recovery  6 Workflows  7 Statistics  8 Workspace   9 Hosts                   HOSTS 
                                                                              Local / 3 heads / 1 running / 3 need attention / 4 to repair 
 Hosts ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
  REMOTE HOSTS                                                                                                                             
  Hydra can run agents on other machines over SSH, for example a build box with more cores or a machine that already has the right         
  toolchain, when a task needs more than this machine offers. Adding a host checks its SSH host key and requirements, installs a matching  
  Hydra there and helps you install and sign in to agents. Nothing changes on the remote until you approve it.                             
                                                                                                                                           
  > + Add a host            set up a machine over SSH                                                                                      
                                                                                                                                           
  Press Enter or A to add a host. Its work then appears in Work beside local heads; L filters by location.
